about: The applications printed, each at every major version its makers still support. Each cell is one version on one kind of machine; in it every program prints the same documents through the application's own Print route, on each system that program installs on. 'reference' is the system and program every other side is compared with.

odoo.name: Odoo
odoo.why: Odoo supports its three latest major versions, and publishes its own Docker image for exactly these three (github.com/odoo/docker).

systems.ubuntu24: Odoo's own Docker image (Ubuntu 24.04), with upstream's wkhtmltopdf 0.12.6.1-3 package as Odoo puts it there
systems.debian13: Debian 13 with Odoo's own Debian package, the same build as in Odoo's image, installed with apt (Debian 13 has no wkhtmltopdf)

erpnext.name: ERPNext
erpnext.why: Frappe supports versions 15 and 16 (its SECURITY.md); frappe_docker builds images for these two only. Version 16 makes PDFs with Chrome unless told otherwise, and version 17 drops wkhtmltopdf; both supported versions still ship it, and here print with it.

systems.bookworm: ERPNext's own Docker image for version 15 (Debian 12), with upstream's wkhtmltopdf 0.12.6.1-3 package for Debian 12 as frappe_docker puts it there
systems.trixie: ERPNext's own Docker image for version 16 (Debian 13), with the same Debian 12 package of wkhtmltopdf 0.12.6.1-3
